misconceptions.description: Ordering revisions by how quick or easy each fix is rather than by impact
misconceptions.trigger: learner schedules trivial quick fixes first and defers a task-blocking defect
misconceptions.feedback: Rank by severity and reach first. A quick fix that does not unblock the goal should not jump ahead of a blocking issue.

misconceptions.description: Letting how often an issue is mentioned outrank how badly it blocks the task
misconceptions.trigger: learner ranks a frequently mentioned cosmetic issue above a less-mentioned task-blocking one
misconceptions.feedback: Weigh severity against reach. A frequent minor complaint does not outrank a barrier that stops users completing the core task.

misconceptions.description: Deprioritizing an accessibility barrier because it does not block the task for most users
misconceptions.trigger: learner ranks a contrast or access issue below a trivial cosmetic fix
misconceptions.feedback: Treat access barriers as carrying weight beyond task completion; do not rank them below trivial fixes.
